Actor Dennis Haskins, known as Principal Belding, dies at 75

Dennis Haskins, who was known for his role as Principal Belding in the television show 'Saved by the Bell,' has died at the age of 75. The Los Angeles Times reported his death, and Hindustan Times provided an update on the cause of death, mentioning health issues.
